messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Jul 10, 2021, Sadaf Rani wrote:
>I am getting this message during building my topology in amber:-
>old PREP-specified impropers:
> <NAP 517>: C18 H20 N4 H21
> <NAP 517>: C14 N1 C18 N4
You can ignore this message: for the past 30 years, the Amber code has been
figuring out impropers itself, and there is no longer a reason for users to
need to check these against those specified in a prep file.
[Scott: this would be a good candidate to remove as an confusing message.
At the least, the word "old" should be removed.]
....dac

messages.author: Sadaf Rani
messages.body:
ok
Thanks.
Sadaf
